owner_report: The user reports that the profit from the earlier rise was fully given back.
interpretation: The main failure was not necessarily directional prediction; the larger issue was profit protection and entry/management discipline after the squeeze payout. The analysis continued to search for fresh long entries after the original long edge had already paid, while the market transitioned into lower-efficiency buyer response and repeated deleveraging. This allowed previously captured edge to be converted back into risk.
root_causes: Signal-generation phase and payoff phase were not separated strictly enough in position management.
After a strong favorable excursion, no hard profit-protection rule was enforced before considering additional entries.
Constructive CVD/OI states were sometimes promoted too quickly from 'candidate' to 'entry' without requiring renewed price acceptance.
The strategy optimized for finding the next entry instead of first protecting accumulated PnL from the existing move.
policy_changes: After a squeeze/impulse payout, freeze new adds until either a confirmed structural retest occurs or a fresh case is opened after reset.
Once a trade reaches a meaningful favorable excursion, define a non-negotiable giveback limit for open PnL before looking for new adds.
CVD/OI can only authorize an entry when price response confirms the thesis; flow without price acceptance remains informational only.
When buyer efficiency deteriorates after a large run, stop averaging into weakness and switch to protect-or-reset mode.
No revenge trade after a full profit giveback; next action requires a new setup with explicit invalidation.
lesson: The edge was found earlier and paid. The failure was converting a profitable move back into risk by continuing to trade the same idea after the payoff phase. Future local-model behavior must prioritize PnL protection and case reset over constant re-entry.
next_required_data: Owner confirmation of whether the position is still open, partially open, or fully closed, plus current exposure if any.
